players.bio: Aaron Tshibola (born 2 January 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Kilmarnock in the Scottish Premier League Tshibola was born in London and came through the youth ranks at Reading before moving to Aston Villa in 2016. He represented England at U18 level in 2013 but has since been called up by DR Congo and played in a friendly match for the side in March 2018.
Bailey Joe Rice is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock, on loan from Rangers.

Calum Ferrie (born 19 June 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock. A former youth team player at Port Vale, he played on loan at Gresley in 2015 before he turned professional at Dundee the following year. He made his first-team debut for Dundee in April 2018.
Cathal McCarthy is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder and centre-back for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock, on loan from Premier League club Hull City.

Djenairo Gillian Noell Daniels (born 7 January 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Suriname national team.
Erik Karl Hugo Ring is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock.
Ethan Schilte-Brown (born June 1, 2005) is a soccer player who plays as a defender for Glentoran FC Belfast . Born in the United States, he represents Canada at youth level.

Ethan Schilte-Brown (born June 1, 2005) is a soccer player who plays as a defender for Glentoran based in Belfast, Northern Ireland . Born in the United States, he represents Canada at youth level. Early life Schilte-Brown was born on June 1, 2005. Born in Richmond, Virginia, United States, he is the son of Canadian soccer coach Denise Schilte-Brown.

George William Stanger (born 15 August 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish club Kilmarnock. Born in Scotland, Stanger has represented New Zealand at youth level, including appearing at the Olympics.
Greg Kiltie (born 18 January 1997) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock.
Jamie Brandon (born 5 February 1998) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a right-back, midfielder or right winger for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock
Joseph Brennen Hugill (born 19 October 2003) is an English footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock.

Johnly Yfeko is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock. He completed a permanent transfer to the club from Exeter City for an undisclosed fee, signing a two-year contract.
Jonathan Meier (born 11 November 1999) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Kilmarnock FC.

Mark Ryan O'Hara (born 12 December 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Kilmarnock. He has previously played for Dundee, Peterborough United, Lincoln City, Motherwell & St Mirren.
Maksymilian Stryjek (born 18 July 1996) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock.
Michael Schjønning-Larsen is a footballer who plays as a left-back for Kilmarnock. Born in Denmark, he represents the Estonia national team.

Michael-John Valentino Kamson-Kamara (born 14 February 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays for Scottish Premiership club Heart of Midlothian, as a defender. Born in Farnborough, Kamson-Kamara began his career as youth with Bromley, and was part of the XYZ Football Academy. He has subsequently played for Lincoln City, Barwell, Peterborough Sports and Glentoran.
Neil Doherty McCann (born 11 August 1974) is a Scottish football pundit, former professional player and coach who is currently the manager of Kilmarnock.
Nicky Cleșcenco is a footballer who plays as a left winger for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock. Born in Ireland, he plays for the Moldova national team.
Nico Mantl (born 6 February 2000) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Primeira Liga club Arouca.

Robbie Deas (born 27 February 2000) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock. Deas has represented Scotland at the under-17, under-19 and under-21 levels.

Rory McKenzie (born 7 October 1993 in Irvine) is a Scottish footballer playing as a striker for Kilmarnock. McKenzie made his Kilmarnock debut as a substitute in a 1–1 draw against Inverness CT on 9 April 2011.

Roshaun Mathurin is a 22-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock F.C.. Born on 23 January 2004, he signed a two-year contract with Kilmarnock in June 2026 after moving from the Slovakian side AS Trenčín.

Scott Tiffoney is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Championship club Raith Rovers, on loan from Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock. Tiffoney started his career in the youth system at St Mirren, and has played for Greenock Morton, Livingston, Partick Thistle and Dundee, as well as numerous loan spells.

Thomas Richard Lowery (born 31 December 1997) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership side Kilmarnock. A graduate of the Crewe Alexandra Academy, Lowery signed his first professional contract with the club in May 2016. He made his Crewe debut on 4 October 2016,

Tyreece Romayo John-Jules (born 14 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Kilmarnock. He has previously played for Charlton Athletic and Arsenal before spending time on loan with Lincoln City, Doncaster Rovers, Blackpool, Sheffield Wednesday, Ipswich Town and Derby County.
